headline: Indonesia Escalates Stock Market Rules Following MSCI Rout
summary: Indonesia is strengthening regulatory measures against stock market manipulation following an equity sell-off triggered by MSCI index rebalancing.
why: Regulatory oversight in emerging stock markets is critical for protecting investor interests and maintaining liquidity during index-driven volatility.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Regulatory interventions seek to curb market manipulation and calm volatility following recent index rebalancing shocks.

why_moved: Indonesian equities suffered a rout triggered by MSCI index adjustments, prompting financial authorities to tighten market manipulation controls.
